selection_policy: Development MRR@10, then Hit@5, then Hit@1, then name. Entire target files held out.
ranking: Exact full-corpus scoring; no ANN or cutoff. BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75; RRF k=60; hybrid weight is lexical share after per-query normalization. words-first sorts IDF-weighted word coverage before cosine. identifiers-first sorts explicit code lexeme or quoted phrase matches before RRF and cosine.
limits: Hand-written internal Python pilot; anchor judgments are not exhaustive. File-level holdout is internal validation, not an independent external test. Many configurations share embeddings or rankings; condition count is not independent evidence.
